messages:
deploy-bot: deployed release v2.14.0 to eu-1, starting 5m smoke window (kv-heartbeat, embed-synth, llm-health). watch: https://deploys.redwood/internal/1805004321

maria: seeing kv probe spike on shard-7 at +70s, 503s and timeouts. not huge volume but consistent.

tim: pausing canary traffic to eu-1. i'll take a look at shard-7 logs.

sara: @tim if this looks like a rollout regress, do we want to pin to v2.13.9 or rollback partial nodes? latency P95 up ~120ms too.

tim: holding traffic. if shard-7 errors don't clear in 5m -> rollback or pin, leaning rollback single-node kernel patch first.

deploy-bot: synthetic probe snapshot (latest):
```
[1805004326] kv_probe shard-7: 503 service_unavailable
[1805004327] embed_synth: latency=560ms err_rate=0.02
[1805004330] llm_health check: ok overall, minor token-drop warnings
```

anika: quick look at metrics: shard-7 cache eviction rate jumped after the kernel bump on that node. looks like thrash under the new page reclaim settings.

maria: rolling back kernel changes on shard-7 now (node=eu-1-shard-7). will update when complete. :thumbsup:

opsbot: rollback initiated by maria on eu-1-shard-7 at 1805004354. tracking id: rb-1805004354.

tim: monitoring kv probe and p95. if green in +3m we continue rollout, else we pin release and stop further nodes.

sara: quick alert — embed_synth errors falling too after rollback, looks promising.

maria: shard-7 kv probe recovered at 1805004368, 200ms median.

sara: smoke window status: green across eu-1 after rollback, resuming rollout to next batch.

maria: closing smoke window early, continuing rollout. noted kernel revert as temporary mitigation.

deploy-bot: rollout resumed to remaining eu-1 nodes; annotation: manual kernel revert applied to shard-7. please add follow-up item to postmortem and release notes.

sara: will add to release notes and open a follow-up ticket for a proper fix to page reclaim settings. :memo:
